headline: New Attack on Riyadh's Tallest Tower in Financial District Leaves 11 Injured
summary: A new attack struck the tallest tower in Riyadh's financial district, injuring 11 people. The Houthis have not claimed this attack, but had claimed an attack on the same tower last week.
why: Riyadh's financial district houses many Saudi banks and corporate headquarters, and attacks there raise security concerns for the Saudi economy and foreign investors.
original_headline: Nuevo ataque contra la torre más alta del distrito financiero de Riad deja 11 heridos
